historical_commentary.text: Published in 1999 as the Euro was being introduced across the European Union, this note addressed a pressing real-world concern for 4D developers serving European businesses. The Euro conversion rules and fixed exchange rates were a one-time transition completed by 2002. The specific resource-manipulation techniques (4DK# and euro resources via BLOBs) are entirely obsolete, but the note is a fascinating snapshot of how 4D developers adapted to a major economic event.
related_updates: Euro adoption was fully completed by 2002; currency conversion logic is no longer needed
4D's resource-based architecture (4DK# resources) has been replaced by modern settings and JSON-based configuration
